Shards are the secondary currency on the Donut SMP and can be used to purchase Tools and [[Amethyst Items|Shard Items]].

== Obtaining ==
As of late, shards can be obtained in two ways; over time by playing the server, and purchased on the Donut SMP store. You used to be able to get shards by idling in the AFK zone and killing other players, however those methods have since been removed.

== Shard Items and their cost on the Shard Shop ==
[[Shard boosters|Shard Potion of Haste]], [[Shard Pickaxe|Shard Pickaxes]] and [[Shard Axe|Shard Axes]] are all items that can be found in the '''Shard Shop.''' Shard Potions of Haste inflict the player that drinks them with Haste 2 for 24 hours, basically being a portable beacon.

Shards can be used to purchase a small variety of items. The items are as follows:

==== SHARD TOOLS ====
* 3k shards each, with the exception of the [[Shard boosters|Shard Potion of Haste]], costing 6k shards.

==== TOOLS ====
*Mace: 2k shards (density and wind burst)
*Netherite Spear: 1.5k shards (with max enchants)
*Netherite Sword: 1.5k shards (with max enchants)
*Netherite Pickaxe (silk touch or fortune): 1k shards
*Netherite Shovel: 800 shards (with max enchants)
*Netherite Axe: 600 shards (with max enchants)
*Netherite Hoe: 500 shards (with max enchants)
*Bow and Crossbow: 500 shards each (crossbow has piercing and bow and mending)

==== ARMOR ====

* All of the armor pieces (netherite, of course) cost 1.5k shards. However, the leggings and boots '''DO NOT''' have Blast Protection
